title: Renaming a whole series renames its moved occurrences too
steps: ⌘⇧P, Show calendar. Move one Standup an hour later and choose This event. Then rename the Standup to Daily sync and choose All events: the moved one is Daily sync too, at its own time.
Rename one Standup to Kickoff (This event), then give the series a place (All events): Kickoff keeps its name and gets the place.
